subject: Chemistry
title: p-Block Elements (Groups 13–18)
summary: p-block elements np subshell bharte hain (ns²np¹⁻⁶) — yahi general configuration hai. Group mein neeche size badhne se non-metallic character ghatta aur metallic character badhta hai.
Inert pair effect bhaari elements mein lower oxidation state ko zyada stable banata hai: Tl⁺ > Tl³⁺, Pb²⁺ > Pb⁴⁺, Bi³⁺ > Bi⁵⁺.
Har group ka first member anomalous hai: chhota size, zyada electronegativity, d orbitals nahi (maximum covalency 4) aur strong pπ–pπ multiple bonding (N≡N, O=O, C=O).

Exam structures aur shapes (VSEPR), hydride aur oxoacid ki acid strength aur thermal stability ke trends, aur important compounds (NH₃, HNO₃, H₂SO₄, ozone, interhalogen, xenon fluorides) par focus karta hai.

formulas.name: General configuration
formulas.formula: ns² np¹⁻⁶;  group number = 10 + valence electrons
formulas.when: Elements place karna aur valence predict karna.

formulas.name: Inert pair effect
formulas.formula: stability of the lower state (group oxidation state − 2) increases down the group
formulas.when: Tl⁺ > Tl³⁺, Pb²⁺ > Pb⁴⁺, Bi³⁺ > Bi⁵⁺.
formulas.note: Isliye PbO₂ aur Bi(V) compounds strong oxidising agents hain.

formulas.name: Hydrides of group 15
formulas.formula: NH₃ > PH₃ > AsH₃ > SbH₃ > BiH₃: basicity and thermal stability decrease; reducing character increases;  bond angle NH₃ 107° > PH₃ 93.6°
formulas.mistake: Boiling point: PH₃ < AsH₃ < NH₃ < SbH₃ < BiH₃ — NH₃ hydrogen bonding ki wajah se anomalously high hai, sabse kam nahi.

formulas.name: Hydrides of group 16
formulas.formula: H₂O < H₂S < H₂Se < H₂Te: acidity increases;  thermal stability decreases down the group
formulas.mistake: Paani ka boiling point hydrogen bonding ki wajah se anomalously high hai — trend se ulta, dhyan rakho.

formulas.name: Hydrogen halides
formulas.formula: acid strength: HF < HCl < HBr < HI;  bond strength and thermal stability: HF > HCl > HBr > HI
formulas.mistake: F sabse electronegative hone ke bawajood HF paani mein sabse KAMZOR acid hai — H–F bond bahut strong, galat mat socho.

formulas.name: Oxoacids of chlorine
formulas.formula: acid strength: HOCl < HClO₂ < HClO₃ < HClO₄;  oxidising power: the reverse

formulas.name: Phosphorus oxoacids (basicity = P–OH bonds)
formulas.formula: H₃PO₂ monobasic (2 P–H, reducing);  H₃PO₃ dibasic (1 P–H, reducing);  H₃PO₄ tribasic (no P–H)
formulas.mistake: Basicity ke liye sirf P se jude O–H bonds gino — P–H hydrogens acidic nahi hain.

formulas.name: Shapes of interhalogens
formulas.formula: XX′ linear;  XX′₃ (ClF₃) T-shaped;  XX′₅ (BrF₅) square pyramidal;  XX′₇ (IF₇) pentagonal bipyramidal

formulas.name: Xenon fluorides
formulas.formula: XeF₂ linear (sp³d);  XeF₄ square planar (sp³d²);  XeF₆ distorted octahedral (sp³d³);  XeO₃ pyramidal

formulas.name: Key preparations
formulas.formula: NH₃: Haber process (Fe catalyst, ~200 atm, ~700 K);  HNO₃: Ostwald process (Pt/Rh, NH₃ oxidation);  H₂SO₄: contact process (V₂O₅ catalyst, SO₂ → SO₃)

formulas.name: Structures of sulphur and phosphorus
formulas.formula: white P: P₄ tetrahedral, reactive, glows;  red P: polymeric, less reactive;  rhombic S (S₈ crowns) stable below 369 K;  monoclinic above

formulas.name: Group 13 & 14 highlights
formulas.formula: boric acid H₃BO₃ is a weak monobasic Lewis acid (accepts OH⁻);  diborane B₂H₆ has two 3-centre-2-electron (banana) bonds;  CO is a neutral oxide and good ligand; CO₂ acidic; SiO₂ covalent network
formulas.when: B, Al, C, Si compounds ke sawal.

examples.title: HF kamzor kyun?
examples.problem: Paani mein HF, HCl se kamzor acid kyun hai?
examples.solution: H–F bond bahut strong hai aur F⁻ chhota aur zor se hydrated, isliye HF bahut kam ionise hota hai; group mein neeche H–X bond kamzor hone se acid strength badhti hai.

examples.title: H₃PO₃ ki basicity
examples.solution: Structure HP(O)(OH)₂: do P–OH bonds → dibasic; P–H hydrogen acidic nahi par H₃PO₃ ko reducing agent banata hai.

examples.title: XeF₄ ki shape
examples.solution: Xe ke 8 valence electrons: 4 bond pairs + 2 lone pairs = 6 pairs (octahedral arrangement, sp³d²). Lone pairs aamne-saamne, isliye molecule square planar.

examples.title: ClF₃ ki shape
examples.solution: Cl: 3 bond pairs + 2 lone pairs = 5 pairs (trigonal bipyramidal). Lone pairs equatorial positions lete hain, molecule T-shaped.

examples.title: Brown ring test
examples.problem: Nitrate test mein brown ring kya banata hai?
examples.solution: Conc. H₂SO₄ mein Fe²⁺ NO₃⁻ ko NO mein reduce karta hai; NO iron se judkar [Fe(H₂O)₅NO]²⁺ banata hai, interface par brown ring dikhta hai.

examples.title: Inert pair effect
examples.problem: PbO₂ strong oxidising agent kyun hai?
examples.solution: Group 14 mein neeche 6s² pair bonding mein hissa nahi lena chahta (inert pair effect), isliye Pb²⁺, Pb⁴⁺ se zyada stable. PbO₂ (Pb⁴⁺) aasaani se electrons lekar Pb²⁺ banta hai.

topics.title: Group 13 (B, Al, Ga, In, Tl)
topics.explain: B non-metal hai aur covalent compounds banata hai; Al amphoteric. Boron halides Lewis acids hain (back-bonding ki wajah se acid strength BF₃ < BCl₃ < BBr₃). AlCl₃ dimer Al₂Cl₆ ki tarah exist karta hai. Borax aur boric acid important boron compounds hain.

topics.title: Group 14 (C, Si, Ge, Sn, Pb)
topics.explain: Carbon catenation dikhata hai (sabse strong C–C bonds) aur allotropes: diamond (sp³, sabse hard), graphite (sp², bijli conduct karta, lubricant), fullerenes (C₆₀). Silicones aur silicates mein Si–O chains; zeolites aluminosilicates hain jo catalysts ki tarah use hote hain.

topics.title: Group 15 (N, P, As, Sb, Bi)
topics.explain: N₂ strong triple bond (941 kJ/mol) ki wajah se inert hai. Nitrogen oxides: N₂O, NO (paramagnetic, odd electron), N₂O₃, NO₂ (paramagnetic, N₂O₄ mein dimerise), N₂O₅. PCl₅ gas mein trigonal bipyramidal aur solid mein [PCl₄]⁺[PCl₆]⁻. Common oxidation states −3, +3, +5; sabhi members hydrides EH₃ (NH₃, PH₃, AsH₃ arsine, SbH₃, BiH₃) aur oxides E₂O₃ aur E₂O₅ banate hain — Sb₂O₅ exist karta hai; sirf Bi ki +5 state unstable hai (inert pair effect). NH₃/NH₄⁺ test: Nessler's reagent (KOH mein K₂HgI₄) brown precipitate deta hai (basic mercury(II) amido-iodide).

topics.title: Group 16 (O, S, Se, Te, Po)
topics.explain: O₂ paramagnetic hai. Ozone (O₃) bent, strong oxidising agent, aur UV se bachata hai. Oxide acidic (SO₂), basic (CaO), amphoteric (Al₂O₃) ya neutral (CO) ho sakta hai. H₂SO₄ dehydrating agent (cheeni ko kaala kar deta hai) aur garam concentrated hone par oxidising agent.

topics.title: Group 17 (F, Cl, Br, I)
topics.explain: Halogens rangeen, strong oxidising agents (F₂ sabse strong), sabse negative electron gain enthalpy (Cl sabse zyada). F sirf −1 dikhata hai. Cl₂ (nam) oxidation se bleach karta hai; thande dilute NaOH se NaCl + NaOCl aur garam concentrated NaOH se NaCl + NaClO₃ (disproportionation).

topics.title: Group 18 (noble gases)
topics.explain: Poori ns²np⁶ shells, bahut zyada ionisation enthalpy. Xenon F aur O se compounds banata hai kyunki uska IE O₂ ke paas hai (Bartlett ne O₂⁺PtF₆⁻, phir Xe⁺PtF₆⁻ banaya). Uses: He balloons aur diving gas mein, Ne signs mein, Ar welding aur bulbs mein inert atmosphere.

topics.title: Anomalous behaviour summary
topics.explain: First members (B, C, N, O, F) chhote, bahut electronegative, d orbitals nahi (covalency ≤ 4) aur strong pπ–pπ multiple bonds banate hain. Bhaari members d orbitals se octet expand karte hain (PCl₅, SF₆) aur dπ–pπ bonds banate hain.

ratta: Inert pair: Tl⁺, Pb²⁺, Bi³⁺ more stable.
HF weakest HX acid;  HI strongest.
H₃PO₂ mono, H₃PO₃ di, H₃PO₄ tribasic.
HClO₄ strongest oxoacid of Cl;  HOCl best oxidiser.
XeF₂ linear, XeF₄ square planar, XeF₆ distorted octahedral.
ClF₃ T-shaped;  BrF₅ square pyramidal;  IF₇ pentagonal bipyramidal.
Group 15: −3, +3, +5;  sabka E₂O₃ aur E₂O₅ (Sb₂O₅ exist karta hai; Bi(V) unstable).
Nessler's reagent (K₂HgI₄ + KOH) + NH₃/NH₄⁺ → brown ppt.
1st IE (kJ/mol): B 801 < C 1086 < O 1314 < N 1402 (N > O anomaly).
